def headers = [:]
headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json; charset=UTF-8'
headers['X_CLIENT_ID'] = _global.nodeParameters?.clientId
headers['X_TENANT_ID'] = _global.nodeParameters?.tenantId
return headers

def response = _global['check_similarity_and_create']
if (!response) {
    throw new Exception('check_similarity_and_create response not found in workflow context.')
}

def incidentId
if (response.isDuplicateIncidentFound) {
    incidentId = response?.similarityResponse?.duplicate?.externalId
} else {
    incidentId = response?.workflowResponse?.workflowEntityId
}

def body = [:]
body['incidentId'] = incidentId
body['issueDetail'] = [:]
body['customer'] = ['customerId': _global.customer?.customerId]
body['orderDetails'] = _global.orderDetails

body['params'] = [
    'issueId'                  : _global.nodeParameters?.issueId,
    'elixirEntityReferenceType': _global.nodeParameters?.elixirEntityReferenceType,
    'elixirEntityReferenceId'  : _global.params?.trackingId,
    'elixirEntityFlow'         : _global.nodeParameters?.elixirEntityFlow,
    'incidentId'               : incidentId,
    'version'                  : _global.nodeParameters?.elixir_wf_version,
    'elixirEntityType'         : _global.nodeParameters?.elixirEntityType,
    'workflowId'               : _global.nodeParameters?.elixir_wf_id
]

return body
